job: Add the three missing AuraBNB dashboard sections to /homes - property pipeline, profit reconciliation, distribution proof - zero-state honest, receipt-required by construction.
context: The AuraBNB audit prescribed 7 sections; /homes has 4 plus the new buy guide. The data layer (lib/homes/fund.ts HomesSnapshot) already carries properties[], distributions[], and windDown; currentHomesSnapshot() returns empty arrays - the sections render their declared-zero states from day one and light up only when receipts exist.
rejectionGates: any non-zero USDC value MUST require >= 1 receipt hash structurally (extend reconcile-style invariants; a fabricated number must be a build failure, not a review comment)
match the existing homes-* CSS system exactly - no new design language
the page is a server component computing from currentHomesSnapshot() at module scope; keep it that way
instructions: 1. fund.ts type additions: chain gains lastVerifiedBlock/verifiedAtISO + a staleness helper; properties entries gain blockers[] and evidence[]; add profitLedger[] (gross, expenses, reserves, net, communityPool, receiptHashes[]); distributions gain snapshotBlock, eligibleCount, claimTxHashes[], unclaimedUsdc.

2. Invariant functions with throw-on-violation: net = gross - expenses - reserves; communityPool = 60% of net (reuse HOMES_PROPERTY_OWNERSHIP); paid + unclaimed = communityPool; any non-zero amount without receiptHashes throws.

3. Page sections in order after the proof register: 'Property pipeline' (empty state: 'No candidate properties. Entries appear with their diligence evidence and blockers.'), 'Profit reconciliation' (the 4-step flow exists - add the ledger table zero state), 'Distribution proof' (snapshot block, eligible count, claim txs - all 'not set').
4. Status bar: add last-verified-block to the homes-status aside once chain.lastVerifiedBlock is non-null (wire it to data/homes/mint-verification.json block via lib, so it is real on day one).
5. Specs: invariant unit tests (fabricated-number-throws is the important one) + UI presence of the three headings and their declared-zero lines.

evidence.delivered: HomesSnapshot gains chain.lastVerifiedBlock/verifiedAtISO (wired to the mint-verification artifact - real block on day one, rendered in the status aside), properties blockers/evidence, profitLedger[], distribution snapshotBlock/eligibleCount/claimTxHashes/unclaimedUsdc. reconcileHomesProfitLedger throws at module scope on money-without-receipts, net != gross-expenses-reserves, pool != 60% net, paid+unclaimed != pool, or money without a snapshot block - a lying dashboard fails the build. Three /homes sections render declared zero states. Specs: 8 invariant assertions incl. every throw path, UI presence of all three sections + the verified-block line.
